# Example drift checks

Examples under `backend/` and `frontend/` must match `template/`. The gate is:

```bash
./scripts/check-examples.sh
```

## What fails the gate

| Check | Failure meaning |
|---|---|
| Nested `.git` | Someone ran `git init` inside an example |
| Kit `diff -rq` | Example `packages/platform-kit` ≠ template kit |
| Frontend render diff | `web-spa` hand-edited vs Copier output |
| Monolith render diff | Scaffold files drifted (excluding `services/` + postgres init) |

## Canonical render answers

**Frontend** (`web-spa`):

```bash
uvx copier copy --trust --defaults --skip-tasks \
  --data stack=frontend \
  --data project_name="Web SPA" --data project_slug=web-spa \
  --data auth_mode=saas --data default_locale=en \
  template /tmp/out
```

**Backend** (`mono-monolith`):

```bash
uvx copier copy --trust --defaults --skip-tasks \
  --data stack=backend \
  --data project_name="My Platform" --data project_slug=my-platform \
  --data repo_layout=monorepo --data architecture=monolith \
  --data messaging=none --data repo_manager=none \
  --data platform_profile=saas --data first_service=core-api \
  template /tmp/out
```

`services/` and `infra/postgres/init` are produced by `dx new-service` / `dx new-saas`, so the script excludes them from the monolith tree diff.

## Fixing drift

1. Change `template/` (or kit in mono-monolith, then rsync)
2. Re-render with the answers above
3. Copy the result over the example (preserving `services/` / locks as needed)
4. Re-run `./scripts/check-examples.sh`
